name: Fine-Tashkeel-CATT_benchmark
description: A benchmark for Arabic fine-grained diacritization (Tashkeel) designed to evaluate models' ability to restore diacritics at word and character levels. It measures morphological and orthographic accuracy on Arabic text, useful for downstream NLP tasks such as TTS, parsing, and machine translation. The benchmark includes gold-standard annotations and supports both token-level labeling and sequence-to-sequence modeling approaches.
reputation: A relevant dataset for the Arabic NLP community, referenced in niche diacritization and Arabic-language modeling work but not yet a universal standard.
